content:
Using the reflection’s distance formula:

\[
c_1-c_2=2(b^3-ab-b)
\]

Since \(b^2=\frac{a+1}{3}\),

\[
b^3-ab-b=b(b^2-a-1)=b\left(\frac{a+1}{3}-a-1\right)
= -2b\cdot \frac{a+1}{3}=-2b^3
\]

Thus

\[
|c_1-c_2|=4b^3
\]

The perpendicular distance is

\[
\frac{4b^3}{\sqrt{2}}=8
\]

so

\[
b^3=2\sqrt{2}=(\sqrt{2})^3
\]

Hence \(b=\sqrt{2}\), so \(b^2=2\). Therefore

\[
\frac{a+1}{3}=2 \implies a=5
\]

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
